title: Oven Roasted Moroccan Basil Seffa
description: A comforting and herbal Moroccan dish featuring basil, this vegan-friendly seffa is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It has a bouncy and qq texture that is sure to please.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the couscous, dried basil, salt, and black pepper.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the water and lemon juice to the skillet and bring the mixture to a boil.
Pour the wet ingredients over the dry ingredients and stir until the couscous is well coated.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover it with aluminum foil.
Bake the seffa in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
